Offering Note(s)</p>

<table cellpadding="0" cellspacing="0" style="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; width: 100%">
<tr style="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
  <td style="width: 15pt; text-align: right">(1)</td><td style="width: 5pt"/>
  <td style="text-align: justify"><ix:nonNumeric name="ffd:OfferingNote" escape="1" contextRef="c_offering_1" id="fee_038">Represents warrants to be issued to the Representative of the underwriters to purchase shares of Common Stock equal to 7% of the Common Shares sold in this offering, including any Common Shares issued upon exercise of the underwriters&#8217; over-allotment option. The Representative&#8217;s Warrants are exercisable at a per share exercise price equal to 100% of the public offering price per share. Pursuant to Rule 457(g) under the Securities Act, the filing fee is calculated based on the exercise price of the Common Shares underlying the Representative&#8217;s Warrants.<br/><br/>No separate registration fee is payable pursuant to Rule 457(g) under the Securities Act.</ix:nonNumeric></td></tr>
  </table>

Pursuant to Rule 457(g) under the Securities Act, the filing fee is calculated based on the exercise price of the Common Shares underlying the Representative&#8217;s Warrants.</ix:nonNumeric></td></tr>
